scene: Inside the pavilion, warm lantern light illuminates delicate porcelain and steaming infusions.
picture: Flat side view inside the wooden tea pavilion. On the far left hangs a painted silk scroll. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre, facing a low wooden table at centre holding a steaming porcelain cup. On the far right is a closed latticed bamboo sliding screen.
shown: A steaming porcelain cup sitting on a low wooden table at centre
A painted hanging silk scroll pinned flat to the wall on the left
A latticed bamboo screen sliding door shut on the far right
